content.title: Assess Twilio credibility and sources
content.description: An enterprise buyer uses customer results, analyst recognition, and the linked sources accordion on the homepage to judge Twilio’s credibility, see quantified proof points, and trace each public claim back to a cited source.
content.summary: Use customer proof and analyst citations to assess credibility.
content.value: Builds trust with proof points and traceable claims before a buyer engages sales.
criteria: The customer results carousel presents at least eight customer entries, each with a logo and a quantified result, and is advanceable by control, swipe, and keyboard.
The analyst recognition band displays three analyst entries, each with a recurrence count and a link to the corresponding report or landing page.
Every analyst and customer claim carries a numbered reference that resolves to an entry in the footer sources accordion.
The sources accordion expands and collapses on activation and is expandable by keyboard.
